description: A forward operating base commander must approve a temporary generator hookup plan for the clinic, communications shelter, and motor pool maintenance bay, including power-source assignments, operating windows, and the checks required before the connections are energized.

shared_context.S1: Generator G-1 provides 60 kilowatts, and Generator G-2 provides 40 kilowatts for the temporary power plan.
shared_context.S2: The clinic requires 25 kilowatts, the communications shelter requires 15 kilowatts, and the motor pool maintenance bay requires 35 kilowatts when its compressor starts.
shared_context.S3: Col. Morgan must approve the hookup plan before the generators are connected, and no generator may be loaded beyond its rated capacity.
shared_context.S4: The base conducts a routine facilities coordination huddle before temporary power changes, during which the facilities, signal, and motor pool representatives report any site-specific requirements.
shared_context.S5: A qualified electrician is available to perform one load test after the hookup assignments and operating windows are approved.

PF1.text: The clinic's temporary transfer panel accepts only the keyed connector from Generator G-1, so the clinic must be assigned to G-1; Maj. Patel confirmed the connector match during this morning's facilities inspection, but the result is not yet on the power-planning slide.

PF2.text: The communications shelter's conditioning unit requires the steadier output of Generator G-2 and must remain on that generator continuously during the plan; Lt. Okafor confirmed this in today's signal-equipment power audit, but the audit has not yet been attached to the facilities request.

PF3.text: The motor pool's compressor startup must be supported by Generator G-1, and the maintenance bay can run that compressor only from 1300 to 1500; SFC Harding recorded the window after coordinating with the maintenance crew this morning, but it has not been posted to the daily power board.

acceptance_conditions: The clinic must be connected to Generator G-1.
The communications shelter must be connected to Generator G-2.
The motor pool maintenance bay must be connected to Generator G-1.
The motor pool compressor operating window must be set to 1300-1500.
A qualified electrician must perform a load test before the connections are energized.
The clinic connector requirement must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'electrical_load_test' and c['target'] == 'all temporary hookups' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The keyed connector requirement changes the clinic's power-source assignment from an open generator choice to exactly G-1.
The conditioning-unit requirement changes the communications shelter's power-source assignment to exactly G-2.
The compressor startup requirement changes the motor pool's source to G-1 and its operating window to exactly 1300-1500.
